cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: He visits the market regularly to buy seeds for his rice field.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: During one such visit he overheard a conversation between Ramanna and Lakshmamma.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: Ramanna said, “Earlier our country had about a lakh varieties of rice.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: Farmers used to preserve different varieties of seeds and use them to grow rice.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: So far, they have collected about a hundred indigenous varieties of rice seeds from different places.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: You can also buy seeds from there.” You may have heard the word ‘lakh’ before.

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: Eshwarappa shared this incident with his daughter Roxie and son Estu .

cards.front: What should you remember from Large Numbers Around Us?
cards.back: Estu was surprised to know that there were about one lakh varieties of rice in this country.
